mapper.sql: id, note_uid, user_id, type, title, content_markdown, structured_payload, source_conversation_uid, source_message_uid, source_text, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_note ( note_uid, user_id, type, title, content_markdown, structured_payload, source_conversation_uid, source_message_uid, source_text, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{noteUid}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{contentMarkdown}, #{structuredPayload}, #{sourceConversationUid}, #{sourceMessageUid}, #{sourceText}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_note SET type = #{type}, title = #{title}, content_markdown = #{contentMarkdown}, structured_payload = #{structuredPayload}, source_conversation_uid = #{sourceConversationUid}, source_message_uid = #{sourceMessageUid}, source_text = #{sourceText}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND note_uid = #{noteUid} AND deleted_at IS NULL
